segments.contextAfter: `completionHandler`: A closure or block that the framework calls when the upload completes. It receives parameters of types [`NSFileVersion`](nsfileversion.md) and [`NSError`](nserror.md). The error is `nil` if fetching the remote version succeeded; otherwise it indicates the error that caused the call to fail. In Swift, you can omit the completion handler, catching any error in a `do`-`catch` block and receiving the version as the return value.
